description: This file defines a Go package for patching pod status in Kubernetes scheduler framework, including a struct for patch calls, methods for execution, merging, and status synchronization.

classes.name: PodStatusPatchCall
classes.description: Represents a call to patch the status of a pod, including methods for execution, merging, and status synchronization.

methods.name: NewPodStatusPatchCall
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new PodStatusPatchCall instance.

methods.name: CallType
methods.description: Returns the API call type, which is PodStatusPatch.

methods.name: UID
methods.description: Returns the UID of the pod associated with the call.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes the patch call, updating the pod status with the provided condition and nominating info.

methods.name: Sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the current pod object with the patch call's condition and nominating info.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges another API call into this one, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: IsNoOp
methods.description: Determines if the patch call results in no operation (no update needed).
